name: Mautic Paragraph
description: Creates a Mautic paragraph Type, Mautic block Type and form
project_description:
Back to top 

 Description 
 This module integrates your Drupal 8 website with Mautic: Open Source Marketing Automation 

 Mautic enables brands to integrate and personalize all their digital properties and channels into a seamless customer experience. With it’s modern approach to marketing automation, Mautic’s suite of tools enables marketers to deliver higher performing campaigns and content, and achieve superior results.

 This module allows you to select forms from a chosen Mautic instance and display on your Drupal 8 website. It allows you to choose between multiple authentication methods to get the list of forms.

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 * Install the Drupal 8+ module via Composer:

 composer require drupal/mautic_paragraph 

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 * Go to your Mautic instance and configure the API settings and in case of OAuth2 the API credentials.

 Note: redirect url should be yourdrupalsitename.com/mautic/callback

 * Go to /admin/config/services/mautic and follow instructions to enter

your credentials.

 * Go to /admin/structure/paragraphs_type/mautic/form-display and choose select list or auto complete list.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 Requirements are :

 
 This Mautic Paragraph module 
 The Mautic API-library [3.1.0] 
 An mautic instance
